name: Saro
summary: Bright white finance-panel site with app icons hanging on threads, tight black Switzer headlines with one electric-blue phrase, and dense, playful UI widgets everywhere.

fonts.pairing: one grotesk at 600 with very tight -4% tracking for display, 400 for body in grey, Geist Mono uppercase for tiny labels

signature: glossy coloured app-icon tiles dangling on thin vertical strings around the hero headline, bobbing on slow loops
statement paragraph with inline app icons set between words, revealed word by word
numbered section tags (blue square with a number and grid glyph beside a label pill) that index the whole page
sticky product tour and a horizontally sliding dark workspace mock driven by scroll
imagery: UI widgets rendered as objects (cards in lime, blue and black, currency converter, balances); a few moody product photos (city at night, gold bars) inside dark dashboard tiles
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, 32px side padding (1136 content), 128px section padding, bento grids of 2/3 + 1/3 columns, 20-24px card radius, pill buttons
